description:
Read: Psa 110:1-4, Jer 31:31-34

One speech seats a Lord until his enemies are the footstool and swears a priesthood forever. The other writes the law inside and says the sins will not be remembered.

a) For people who already hold that the Son is priest and that the new covenant is in force, what do these two texts still require to be unfinished, and what do they require to be finished?
